comments.author: Naoyasu
comments.body: The best spot I've found is the small bay where Nantes is, but you have to be really really close to land, like almost running aground, even actually running aground (hey that's what lumber and repair skill are for :-)). So sailing north to south along that little cove and back, almost touching the ground for 12 days, I'm getting like 80 - 100 oysters. Collecting at r9 and (very important) college skills Field Activities 1 and Field Activities 2 both loaded. It's advisable to also load at least one of the Reduced Disaster Frequency college skills and/or carry some "decoy" trade goods too, as you don't want your hard-collected oysters burned or eaten by rats.
